notes.title: Surabaya Inferno 1.53 released
notes.content:
Dear everyone.

Now Surabaya Inferno 1.53 has released.

So what different from 2020 version?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/c30a7af88e6ad4e42a6745ba2b3481460d28c0fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/9ec3841d5f818629be6446782b25dd0cc8a8d2a5.png[/img]
[b]Graphics![/b]
If you see current screenshot, we updated most of graphics with pixel style since this style very suit with Surabaya Inferno theme

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/a25c31777b8d32698fc3c4c57b87bbe1a2f5a643.jpg[/img]
[b]New User Interface 
[/b]

As you can see, new user interface very good compare previous verison
[previewyoutube=PwpJ3oA6p8g;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[b]New Original Soundtracks[/b]
There are 3 new original  in Surabaya Inferno 2022. This original soundtracks actully created in 2020 after Surabaya Inferno 2020 released, but since Sengkala Dev never update this game, we never publish this tracks.
3 new soundtracks represeted the Indian troops in Surabaya.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/155ac89ec3342143da9707b868519e301b7168d1.png[/img]
Improved Gameplay Mechanics

In new version, you will experience beter gameplay system compare previous version such the short tutorial in each arcs 


This is what we can explain now. Hope we can update more since there are many plan for this version.

Thank you

Sengkala Dev

notes.title: Surabaya Inferno First update
notes.content:
After 1 week our game got released, this is good time to update our game.
There are many things that we fix and update 
[b]List fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] In User Interface, there are no texts of units name and replaced with number of units.
[*]now player can send units with 3 option button (we converting this texts to buttons). So you can send either with enter A,B, or C or just press in option.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/77e6cb7d0fb8a39ff63cad75da4af5c134271e2a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/0a5a07b750b2f827b3a56cb7ae1b43405a8a2390.png[/img][/url]
[*] There are soundeffects when players send units 
[*] Now bofors sprite can change depend on there position of mouse
[*] Newest manual guide attached in game folder
[/list]

Soon there are another update...
